name: Tower Defense
hook: Build towers together. Hold the path.
how: Enemies walk the path in waves. Spend the team's shared gold on archers, cannons, frost and spark towers, and upgrade them. Lose 20 lives and the castle falls.
controls: Pick a tower, then click or tap a tile. Click a tower to upgrade or sell it
uses: The host's browser moves the enemies, runs the waves and keeps the shared gold; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
The furthest wave your team reached.
AI builders place and upgrade towers until enough people join.
Everyone sees each other's cursors, towers and shots as they happen.
ideas: Add a flying enemy that skips the path
